newsitem.title: USA: Crown Energy asphalt facility approved.
newsitem.headline: Crown Energy asphalt facility approved.

text.p: Crown Energy Corp said on Monday that it has received final regulatory approvals to build an asphalt plant at the company's Asphalt Ridge oil and sand deposit near Vernal, Utah.

The facility, located on 45 acres of Crown's 7,500 acre site at Asphalt Ridge, is designed to initially process approximately 2,000 tons of oil sands daily for an average production of 1,000 barrels of premium asphalt per day over an estimated 15-year life, the company said.
The plant is expected to cost approximately $15 million, which will be funded by an offering of debt, convertible debt or convertible preferred stock in a private placement, a company spokesman said.
Crown anticipates shipping product during the 1997 construction season and will expand output from the facility in 1998 in response to market demand, the company said.

Middleton indicated that while awaiting regulatory approval, Crown has been evaluating financing alternatives and has proven attractive to a number of well-respected names in the industry, the company said.
